title: Writing Task 2: Essay Structure
ringkas: Jenis esai, thesis, paragraf isi, kesimpulan, dan contoh jawaban
goals: mengenali **lima jenis esai** Task 2 dan apa yang diminta masing-masing
menyusun **paragraf isi**: kalimat topik, penjelasan, contoh

lesson.text: **Writing Task 2** adalah esai minimal 250 kata dalam sekitar 40 menit. Nilainya lebih besar daripada Task 1, jadi kerjakan Task 2 dengan serius. **Catatan:** situs ini tidak menilai esaimu. Pakai struktur dan contoh di sini, lalu minta guru atau teman mahir memeriksa.

lesson.title: 1. Lima jenis esai
table: [[To what extent do you agree or disagree?]]
[[Discuss both views and give your opinion.]]
bahas dua sisi lalu beri pendapat
[[What problems does this cause? What can be done?]]
[[Why is this happening? Is it positive or negative?]]

lesson.title: 3. Pengantar dan thesis
table: [[Some people think children should learn a second language at primary school.]]
[[It is argued by some that young pupils should study a foreign language.]]
[[I strongly agree because it improves their future opportunities and develops their memory.]]
[[This essay will discuss both views before giving my own opinion.]]

lesson.title: 4. Paragraf isi (PEEL)
table: [[Firstly, learning a language early improves memory.]]
[[Young brains are flexible, so they absorb new sounds easily.]]
[[For instance, children in bilingual families often speak two languages fluently.]]

lesson.title: 5. Kesimpulan
table: [[I firmly believe that children should start learning languages early.]]
[[Schools should therefore make it part of the curriculum.]]

lesson.title: Rencanakan 5 menit
lesson.text: Sebelum menulis, habiskan 5 menit: tentukan posisi, dua gagasan utama, dan satu contoh untuk tiap gagasan. Esai yang terencana lebih runtut dan lebih mudah selesai tepat waktu.

lesson.title: Jawab soalnya
lesson.text: Esai yang bagus tetapi tidak menjawab pertanyaan akan kehilangan nilai Task Response. Baca perintah, lalu pastikan setiap paragraf kembali ke soal.

practice.q: Kalimat mana yang termasuk kesimpulan?
options: In conclusion, I firmly believe that early language learning is beneficial.
For instance, bilingual children speak fluently.
Some people think children should learn languages.

practice.q: Kalimat mana yang termasuk contoh?
options: For instance, children in bilingual families speak two languages.
This essay will discuss both views.

practice.q: Kalimat mana yang termasuk thesis opinion?
options: I strongly agree because it improves their future opportunities.

practice.q: Kalimat thesis untuk esai discussion:
options: This essay will discuss both views before giving my own opinion.

options: I strongly agree that working from home benefits both staff and employers.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat transisi untuk paragraf isi kedua:
options: On the other hand, there are some drawbacks to consider.
And then the next thing is my second idea here.
Now I will talk about the other paragraph next in my opinion.
The second paragraph is here, so please read it these days.
practice.exp: On the other hand dipakai untuk sisi lain.

practice.q: Pilih contoh yang paling kuat:
options: In Finland, students start school at seven, yet they achieve high test scores.
In some places, students do many different things at school in general.
Many children go to school every day in most countries at the moment.
This is true for most people in the world today.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat dengan hedging yang tepat:
options: This may lead to a decline in face-to-face communication.
This will definitely destroy all communication most of the time.
This always leads to the end of communication most of the time.
This is the only cause of poor communication.

practice.q: Pilih counter-argument yang baik:
options: Admittedly, some people believe that online classes are less effective.
Everyone knows that online classes are always bad for students as far as I know.
I do not like online classes at all, so I stay away.
Online classes are classes that students take online these days.

practice.q: Pilih kesimpulan yang baik:
options: In conclusion, the benefits of public transport outweigh its costs.
In conclusion, I have a new idea about taxis and trains most of the time.
That is all I have to say about public transport now.
To conclude, transport is a very big topic for everyone.

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang paling akademik:
options: Governments ought to invest in renewable energy.
Governments gotta put money in green stuff in my opinion.
The government should do energy things these days.
Energy is good so government pays.
practice.exp: Gaya formal. Jawaban yang tepat: **Governments ought to invest in renewable energy.**
